title: PH Coast Guard repels 5 foreign fishing vessels near Kota Island
summary: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), in coordination with the Philippine Navy and Philippine Marine Corps, repelled five unauthorized foreign fishing vessels from the waters near Kota Island in Palawan…

blocks.text: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), in coordination with the Philippine Navy and Philippine Marine Corps, repelled five unauthorized foreign fishing vessels from the waters near Kota Island in Palawan on Sunday.
